summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Go binary with a hardcoded WebSocket-driven remote PTY backdoor and Anthropic API key harvester
details: The tarball's sole payload bin/sxt is a Go Mach-O binary that opens a remote WebSocket channel to a hardcoded C2 (wss://relay.sextant.top) and links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket to drive an interactive PTY on the installer's host — a full-host remote shell. The binary additionally embeds pion/webrtc for a P2P data-channel control path, references https://relay.sextant.top/install with tokens matching sudo/curl-based privileged installer flows, and contains a regex ("sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}") together with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, https://claude.ai/install.sh, and @google/gemini-cli references — scaffolding to harvest the installer's Anthropic/Gemini API keys and exfiltrate them over the same relay. package.json strips author/homepage metadata and points the license field at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repo name that matches the binary's remote-control-of-Claude capability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
